_readme: Delivery settings. Change numbers only (keep the quotes and commas). See HOW_TO_EDIT.md, section 'Delivery checker'.

shop._howToFill: Open Google Maps, right-click the exact shop door, click the two numbers shown to copy them. First number = latitude, second = longitude. Or open the website with ?setup=1 at the end of the address and click the shop on the map.
